req.title: Logout clears session
req.statement: The system shall clear the session and redirect to / on GET /auth/logout.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the session should be cleared and a redirect should occur when accessing the logout endpoint. Tests are designed to verify this behavior under different conditions, ensuring robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_logout_clears_session_and_redirects
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as a user
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Perform logout
r = client.get('/auth/logout')

# Check if session is cleared and redirected
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_logout_boundary_case
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as a user
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Perform logout
r = client.get('/auth/logout')

# Check if session is cleared and redirected
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

# Attempt to access a protected page
r = client.get('/create')

# Check if redirected to login due to cleared session
assert r.status_code == 302
assert '/auth/login' in r.headers['Location']
